personalInfo.bio:
Passionate Python developer with 7+ years of experience building backend systems, data pipelines, and scalable APIs. Currently leading technical teams, designing architectures, and mentoring developers. Skilled in modern Python frameworks (FastAPI, Django), asynchronous programming, and database design. Always seeking ways to improve codebases and team dynamics through patterns, documentation, and clear processes.
Looking for opportunities to continue growing in architecture, clean code, and high-impact backend systems.
